slides.notes: Goal: share what four weeks of assessment found, and agree on a 12-week plan. All names and figures in this deck are fictional.
Four blocks, about 25 minutes, then questions.

text.[Key message 1]: Alert noise, not missing coverage, is what hides real incidents.
text.[Key message 2]: Fixing five noisy sources removes most of that noise in six weeks.
text.[Key message 3]: The plan needs one owner per team and read-only access to start.
